notes.title: NEWS - DISCORD SERVER IS UP
notes.notes:
The Air VR Discord Channel is up! Here is a link that you can join here: https://discord.gg/sCZQ8E63Nx
Invite your friends! This link will also be available on the Air VR Steam Store page. 
I wanted to start Dicord server where I can build a community around the game. In this server people can get information, early access to the game, and even leave questions for me about the game. I will be periodically posting updates about the game in the discord community as well. Make sure to check it out and say what's up!

notes.title: NEWS - WELCOME TO AIR VR
notes.notes:
Welcome to the first Air VR community update. I think it's about time I started doing these to update you all on the state of the game. 

I guess I can use this post to quickly introduce myself. My name is Airic and I have been working on Air VR for a while now. My dream is to make a game that has the type of hyper mobile combat mechanics that I have always wanted to see implemented in a VR game. My goal is to bring this to the VR community and give people the feeling of flying and moving around with the type of freedom not commonly found in many VR titles. I am only a solo indie developer so I really hope I can make something people can enjoy. 

Further up the development of the game I will be posting updates here on Steam and Discord to keep people up to speed with everything. Expect screenshots, video clips, and opportunities to test the game. I am really looking forward to this process and hopefully meeting some likeminded people who can enjoy Air VR.

See you at the top!
